title: SanDisk CEO David Goeckeler Says Its Biggest Customers Aren't Talking Prices Anymore as Business Turns 'Highly Strategic'

content_html:

SanDisk Corp. said artificial intelligence is fundamentally changing how it works with customers, with CEO David Goeckeler describing a shift from short-term pricing negotiations to long-term strategic partnerships as demand for AI infrastructure accelerates.

From Quarterly Price Talks To Long-Term Strategy

During the chipmaker's fourth-quarter earnings call, Goeckeler said discussions with customers have moved beyond procurement teams and now involve the CEOs and CFOs of some of the world's largest companies as AI infrastructure becomes a strategic priority.

"This used to be, quite frankly, just a supply chain conversation every quarter in a price negotiation 7×24," Goeckeler said, adding that SanDisk is now playing a "highly strategic" role in helping customers build AI infrastructure.

Customers Already Returning For More AI Capacity

The shift has also translated into longer visibility and repeat demand.

SanDisk's largest customers have already returned to expand their multi-year agreements just one quarter after signing them, reinforcing the company's confidence in long-term AI-driven demand.

The company now has more than four years of visibility into customer commitments, compared with just a few months a year ago.

"We spent a lot of time over the last 2 or 3 quarters really working very, very deeply with our largest customers on committing demand over. We have over 4 years of visibility now," Goeckeler added.

Trending: Avoid the #1 Investing Mistake: How Your 'Safe' Holdings Could Be Costing You Big Time

Results And Outlook

SanDisk reported fourth-quarter adjusted earnings of $39.25 per share, beating analyst estimates of $34.45 per share, according to Benzinga Pro.

Revenue rose to $8.97 billion, ahead of analyst expectations of $8.39 billion and up sharply from $1.9 billion a year earlier.

For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, the company expects revenue of $10.3 billion to $10.8 billion and adjusted earnings of $44.00 to $46.00 per share, compared with analyst estimates of $10.37 billion in revenue and $41.45 per share in adjusted earnings.

SanDisk 公司表示，人工智能正在从根本上改变其与客户的合作方式，首席执行官 David Goeckeler 描述了随着人工智能基础设施需求的加速，从短期定价谈判到长期战略合作伙伴关系的转变。

从季度价格谈判到长期战略

在这家芯片制造商的第四季度财报电话会议上，Goeckeler 表示，随着人工智能基础设施成为战略重点，与客户的讨论已经超出了采购团队的范围，现在涉及一些全球最大公司的首席执行官和首席财务官。

Goeckeler 表示：“坦率地说，这过去只是每个季度 7×24 小时的价格谈判中的供应链对话。”他补充说，SanDisk 现在在帮助客户构建人工智能基础设施方面发挥着“高度战略性”的作用。

客户已经回归寻求更多人工智能能力

这种转变还转化为更长的可见度和重复需求。

SanDisk 的最大客户在签订多年协议仅一个季度后就已恢复扩展，这增强了该公司对人工智能驱动的长期需求的信心。

该公司现在对客户承诺的了解已超过四年，而一年前只有几个月。

“在过去的两三个季度中，我们花了很多时间与我们最大的客户进行非常非常深入的合作，以承诺需求。 我们现在已经有超过 4 年的知名度了，”Goeckeler 补充道。

趋势：避免第一大投资错误：你的“安全”持仓可能会让你付出巨大的代价

结果与展望

据 Benzinga Pro 称，闪迪第四季度调整后每股收益为 39.25 美元，超出分析师预期的每股 34.45 美元。

营收增至 89.7 亿美元，高于分析师预期的 83.9 亿美元，且较上年同期的 19 亿美元大幅增长。

该公司预计2027财年第一季度收入为103亿美元至108亿美元，调整后每股收益为44.00美元至46.00美元，而分析师预计收入为103.7亿美元，调整后每股收益为41.45美元。
